searchText: Digging into some Teku logs on Pyrmont and I notice that all of our nodes reported an invalid signature for what I believe was this missed block on 9 Jan: https://pyrmont.beaconcha.in/block/372481 Should have come from prysm_team. I think <@!399309815517544451> discovered some issues with a db migration gone wrong around that time so could be an artefact of that, but we've had issues with invalid signatures a fair while back because of validator duties not handling late blocks properly so thought I'd mention it in case its a sign of something bigger. Unfortunately I don't have the block itself. Actually quite a stream of them now that I go looking, so that lends a lot of credit to the idea that it was the bad db migration. We had an issue with duties performed delayed, sometimes 30 seconds or longer that assigned. Then we messed up a db migration which caused a partial outage. So it is very possible that you saw a very late block proposed from us It was resolved on Friday though Oh ok this is a Friday block Yeah the most recent of this was about the time I got a message from you on Telegram detecting the issue. The time I got the block lines up with that missed slot so I don't think it's just late. It definitely had an invalid signature, but that could mean it was signed by the wrong validator. Interesting... I will crawl our logs too. We made a bit of a mess on Friday night 😳 A sample of some other times I got blocks with invalid signatures (all UTC): Dec 29, 2020 @ 04:48:43.983 Dec 29, 2020 @ 04:27:19.865 Dec 29, 2020 @ 03:48:07.876 Dec 29, 2020 @ 03:27:43.456 I don't think I have any before then.
